sentences.text: The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.55097/2020 pending before the XXIX Additional C.M.M., Bengaluru, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison would submit that the parties to the lis who are wife - petitioner and the husband - respondent No.2, were before the family Court in Crl.Misc.No.377/2020 and have settled their family dispute and entered into Khulanama.
A copy of memorandum of settlement under Section 89 of CPC read with Rules 24 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules, 2005 is filed to that effect before this Court.
The conditions of the settlement includes the closure of the impugned proceedings in the subject petition.
It is also submitted that the parties would adhere to the terms of settlement.

3. The memorandum of settlement under Section 89 of CPC read with Rules 24 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules, 2005, reads as follows:
NC: 2023:KHC:24899 "7.

In view of the settlement arrived to between the parties,
the petitioner has agreed to assist in closing / quashing C.C.No.55067/2020 filed under Section 498A of IPC pending before XXIX Addl. CMM Court, Mayohall,
Bengaluru.
The petitioner has also agreed to withdraw Crl.Misc.108/2020 filed under DV Act pending before MMTC-I Court, Mayohall, Bengaluru."

In the light of the afore-extracted memorandum of settlement for having arrived at settlement of the dispute among the parties to the lis, I deem it appropriate to obliterate the proceedings initiated against the petitioners, as it is a matrimonial dispute and the alleged offences are not against the State.

4. For the aforestated reasons, the following:
ORDER i. The Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. The proceedings in C.C.No.55097/2020 pending before the XXIX Additional C.M.M., Bengaluru, stand quashed.
